title: Receiver Behavior checks only account-level receiptSharing, not per-chat override
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md Receiver Behavior (Peer/receipt) checks only PresenceStatus.receiptSharing. The Sender Behavior correctly resolves both levels (Chat.receiptSharing takes precedence over account-level), but Receiver Behavior ignores Chat.receiptSharing. A recipient who opted out at the per-chat level will still receive inbound read-receipt state-change events for that chat. Asymmetry between Sender and Receiver Behavior will cause incorrect implementations. Fix: Receiver Behavior must apply the same two-level resolution.
